change: Odd-first applicable 4D trace contractions, continuous chain-aware metric contraction, repeated-index guard reused for chain/vector rules.
scope: Ordinary and axial traces use the shared cyclic priority; adjacent pairs remain first. Open chains and generic-dimensional/slash-only pairs retain shortest-pair ordering.
timing_method: Five warm samples per method, methods interleaved with rotating order; target8ms batches, at least one call. Same benchmark driver and dev-optim optimization (level2, debug info2) before/after, pinned CPU6 on a shared host. Input creation, warmup, validation and snapshots excluded; result destruction included. Before binary links the saved pre-change Idenso library. FORM is separately pinned CPU3 and includes amortized startup, parsing, trace4, sorting and cleanup. No equality or parity claim comes from timing or term counts.
count_semantics: Benchmark output_terms means top-level Add arity only; nested factorized sums are not expanded. FORM generated_terms is cumulative sorter submissions and sorted_terms is collected polynomial size. Neither is peak resident memory.

methodology.wall: One warmup process, then three measured processes. Six batches per process; entire wall time divided by total traces. Includes process startup, parsing/input normalization, trace4, sorting, count printing, drop and shutdown. Polynomial printing and exact checks excluded.
methodology.cpu: FORM internal timer covers trace4 plus .sort after input preparation; median last five of six batches, divided by traces per batch; median across three measured processes. Millisecond timer resolution applies per batch.
methodology.counts: Generated terms count StoreTerm submissions to sorter; sorted terms count final monomials after trace4+.sort. Neither is peak resident terms. Separate untimed run writes normalized input and complete polynomial.
methodology.scope: Independent p_i vectors and explicit4D Lorentz indices a,b,c,d,mu_i. No numeric/on-shell specialization. FORM fully normalizes external metrics before trace4. Idenso input construction is excluded from its timer; amortized FORM wall includes parsing/input preparation.
methodology.host: Shared host; CPU3 affinity inherited by child processes. Results are measurements, not a claim of equivalence based on term counts.

validation.scope: Seven reductions subtract to symboliczero in FORM. Two gamma5 reductions leave Schouten combinations after sorting; all nine original and reduced traces agree at three exact integer4D vector assignments with nonzero original values. These are within-FORM checks, not cross-library tensor-network validation.

archive.contents: Complete programs, raw logs, measurement script, exactidentity/component checks, source identities, full summary.

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re,statistics,subprocess,time
ROOT=Path(__file__).parent
INPUTS=json.load(open(ROOT/'inputs.json'))
FORM=INPUTS['form_executable']
REPETITIONS={'order_sensitive_12':600,'external_metrics_12':600,'ordinary_odd_8':3000,'ordinary_even2_8':5000,'ordinary_even4_10':400,'ordinary_cyclic_12':150,'axial_odd_8':3000,'axial_even4_10':1000,'axial_crossing_12':1500,'free_8':600,'free_12':40,'axial_12':150}
records=[]
for case in INPUTS['cases']:
    n=REPETITIONS[case['case']]
    program='Off Statistics;\n'+INPUTS['header']+f"""#do batch=1,6
#do j=1,{n}
Local F`j'={case['expression']};
#enddo
.sort
#reset timer
trace4,1;
.sort
#write "BATCH_CPU_MS=`timer_'"
#$n=termsin_(F1);
#write "TERMS=%$",$n
Drop;
.sort
#enddo
.end
"""
    path=ROOT/f"{case['case']}-timing.frm";path.write_text(program)
    wall=[];cpu=[];raw_cpu=[];raw_logs=[]
    for sample in range(4):
        started=time.perf_counter_ns()
        p=subprocess.run([FORM,'-q',str(path)],cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
        elapsed=(time.perf_counter_ns()-started)/(n*6)
        path.with_suffix(f'.{sample}.log').write_text(p.stdout)
        raw_logs.append(p.stdout)
        times=list(map(int,re.findall(r'BATCH_CPU_MS=(\d+)',p.stdout)))
        counts=list(map(int,re.findall(r'TERMS=(\d+)',p.stdout)))
        assert len(times)==6 and counts==[case['sorted_terms']]*6,(times,counts)
        if sample:
            wall.append(elapsed);cpu.append(statistics.median(times[1:])*1e6/n);raw_cpu.append(times)
    record=dict(case=case['case'],idenso_case='free_trace_8'if case['case']=='free_8'else case['case'],expression=case['expression'],normalized_input=case['normalized_input'],generated_terms=case['generated_terms'],sorted_terms=case['sorted_terms'],traces_per_batch=n,batches_per_process=6,wall_ns_samples=wall,wall_ns_median=statistics.median(wall),cpu_ns_samples=cpu,cpu_ns_median=statistics.median(cpu),raw_batch_cpu_ms=raw_cpu,timing_program=program,raw_timing_output=raw_logs,counts_program=case['counts_program'],counts_output=(ROOT/f"{case['case']}-counts.log").read_text())
    records.append(record)
    summary=dict(schema_version=1,date='2026-09-24',form_executable=FORM,form_version=INPUTS['version'],form_executable_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(FORM).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),source_url='https://github.com/form-dev/form/blob/v5.0.0/sources/opera.c',source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path('/tmp/trace-intermediate-form/form-5.0.0/sources/opera.c').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),cpu=3,methodology=dict(wall='One warmup process, then three measured processes. Six batches per process; entire wall time divided by total traces. Includes process startup, parsing/input normalization, trace4, sorting, count printing, drop and shutdown. Polynomial printing and exact checks excluded.',cpu='FORM internal timer covers trace4 plus .sort after input preparation; median last five of six batches, divided by traces per batch; median across three measured processes. Millisecond timer resolution applies per batch.',counts='Generated terms count StoreTerm submissions to sorter; sorted terms count final monomials after trace4+.sort. Neither is peak resident terms. Separate untimed run writes normalized input and complete polynomial.',scope='Independent p_i vectors and explicit4D Lorentz indices a,b,c,d,mu_i. No numeric/on-shell specialization. FORM fully normalizes external metrics before trace4. Idenso input construction is excluded from its timer; amortized FORM wall includes parsing/input preparation.',host='Shared host; CPU3 affinity inherited by child processes. Results are measurements, not a claim of equivalence based on term counts.'),records=records)
    (ROOT/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(f"{case['case']:26} {case['generated_terms']:5} -> {case['sorted_terms']:5}; wall {record['wall_ns_median']/1000:9.3f} us, CPU {record['cpu_ns_median']/1000:9.3f} us",flush=True)

if (ROOT/"validation.json").exists():
    summary["validation"]=json.load(open(ROOT/"validation.json"))
    summary["reproduction_command"]="taskset -c 3 python3 measure.py"
    (ROOT/"summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+"\n")
